(setvar "CMDECHO" 0)
(setvar "DELOBJ" 1)
(command "_.UCS" "_World")
(defun p2 (r a / q) (setq q (* pi (/ a 180.0))) (list (* r (cos q)) (* r (sin q))))
(defun mkpoly (pts / d)
  (setq d (list '(0 . "LWPOLYLINE") '(100 . "AcDbEntity") '(100 . "AcDbPolyline")
                (cons 90 (length pts)) '(70 . 1)))
  (foreach p pts (setq d (append d (list (cons 10 p)))))
  (entmakex d))
(defun solid-count (/ s) (setq s (ssget "_X" '((0 . "3DSOLID")))) (if s (sslength s) 0))
(setq z0 0.0 thk 7.21 rr 45.465 rt 51.50)
(command "_.CYLINDER" "_non" (list 0.0 0.0 z0) rr thk)
(setq base (entlast))
(setq i 0)
(repeat 24
  (setq a (* i 15.0))
  (setq pts (list (p2 rr (- a 7.50)) (p2 47.15 (- a 5.10))
                   (p2 50.65 (- a 2.70)) (p2 rt a)
                   (p2 50.65 (+ a 2.70)) (p2 47.15 (+ a 5.10))
                   (p2 rr (+ a 7.50))))
  (setq pl (mkpoly pts))
  (command "_.EXTRUDE" pl "" thk)
  (setq tooth (entlast))
  (command "_.UNION" base tooth "")
  (setq base (entlast))
  (setq i (1+ i)))
(princ (strcat "\nAFTER_TOOTH_UNIONS_SOLIDS=" (itoa (solid-count))))
(command "_.CYLINDER" "_non" (list 0.0 0.0 -20.79) 30.0 28.0)
(setq hub (entlast))
(command "_.UNION" base hub "")
(setq base (entlast))
(princ (strcat "\nAFTER_HUB_UNION_SOLIDS=" (itoa (solid-count))))
(command "_.REGEN")
(princ "\nSTAGE1_COMPLETE")
(princ)

(progn
  (setvar "CMDECHO" 0)
  (setvar "INSUNITS" 4)
  (setvar "DELOBJ" 1)
  (command "_.UCS" "_W")
  (defun mkbox (p1 p2 h / e)
    (command "_.BOX" p1 p2 h)
    (setq e (entlast))
  )
  (defun mkcyl (p r h / e)
    (command "_.CYLINDER" p r h)
    (setq e (entlast))
  )
  (defun mkcone (p r1 r2 h / e)
    (command "_.CONE" p r1 r2 h)
    (setq e (entlast))
  )
  (defun sub1 (base cut)
    (command "_.SUBTRACT" base "" cut "")
    base
  )
  (defun add1 (a b)
    (command "_.UNION" a "" b "")
    a
  )

  ;; 100 x 7 x 4.8 miniature guide rail, centered at origin
  (setq rail (mkbox '(-50.0 -3.5 0.0) '(50.0 3.5 0.0) 4.8))

  ;; Longitudinal bearing reliefs on both sides of the rail
  (setq g1 (mkbox '(-50.1 -3.6 2.15) '(50.1 -2.9 2.15) 1.15))
  (sub1 rail g1)
  (setq g2 (mkbox '(-50.1 2.9 2.15) '(50.1 3.6 2.15) 1.15))
  (sub1 rail g2)

  ;; Rail M2 countersunk mounting holes: 5 end offset, 15 pitch
  (foreach x '(-45.0 -30.0 -15.0 0.0 15.0 30.0 45.0)
    (setq hc (mkcyl (list x 0.0 -0.1) 1.1 5.0))
    (sub1 rail hc)
    (setq hs (mkcone (list x 0.0 4.81) 2.05 1.1 -1.15))
    (sub1 rail hs)
  )
  (princ "\nSTAGE_RAIL_OK")

  ;; Carriage: 22.5 x 17 overall, top at Z=8; stepped end caps
  (setq carr (mkbox '(-11.25 -8.5 4.0) '(11.25 8.5 4.0) 3.55))
  (setq cap (mkbox '(-6.75 -8.5 7.45) '(6.75 8.5 7.45) 0.55))
  (add1 carr cap)

  ;; Four M2 tapped mounting holes on 8 x 12 pattern
  (foreach p '((-4.0 -6.0) (4.0 -6.0) (-4.0 6.0) (4.0 6.0))
    (setq mh (mkcyl (list (car p) (cadr p) 3.9) 0.8 4.3))
    (sub1 carr mh)
  )
  (princ "\nSTAGE_CARRIAGE_OK")

  ;; Carriage and rail overlap from Z=4.0 to 4.8 and become one solid
  (add1 rail carr)
  (setq final rail)
  (entmod (append (entget final) '((8 . "0"))))
  (command "_.ZOOM" "_E")

  (setq typ (cdr (assoc 0 (entget final))))
  (setq solids 0)
  (setq ss (ssget "_X" '((0 . "3DSOLID"))))
  (if ss (setq solids (sslength ss)))
  (princ (strcat "\nFINAL_TYPE=" typ " SOLID_COUNT=" (itoa solids)))
  (if (and (= typ "3DSOLID") (= solids 1))
    (princ "\nBUILD_VALID")
    (progn (princ "\nBUILD_INVALID") (quit))
  )
  (princ)
)

  (princ (strcat "\nFINAL_TYPE=" typ " SOLID_COUNT=" (itoa outn)))
  (princ (strcat "\nDB_EXTENTS="
    (rtos (- (car emax) (car emin)) 2 4) ","
    (rtos (- (cadr emax) (cadr emin)) 2 4) ","
    (rtos (- (caddr emax) (caddr emin)) 2 4)))
  (if (and (= outn 1) (= typ "3DSOLID"))

(setvar "CMDECHO" 0)
(setvar "INSUNITS" 4)
(setvar "MEASUREMENT" 1)
(command "_.UCS" "_W")

(defun solid-count (/ s)
  (setq s (ssget "_X" '((0 . "3DSOLID"))))
  (if s (sslength s) 0)
)
(defun require-one (stage)
  (if (/= (solid-count) 1)
    (progn
      (princ (strcat "\nBOOLEAN_CHECK_FAILED at " stage " count=" (itoa (solid-count))))
      (quit)
    )
    (princ (strcat "\nBOOLEAN_CHECK_OK " stage " count=1"))
  )
)
(defun subtract-cutter (body cutter stage)
  (command "_.SUBTRACT" body "" cutter "")
  (require-one stage)
)

; Outer footprint: 38 long x 24 wide with the two unnumbered front corner chamfers.
(command "_.PLINE"
  '(0.0 3.0) '(3.0 0.0) '(38.0 0.0)
  '(38.0 24.0) '(3.0 24.0) '(0.0 21.0) "_C")
(setq outline (entlast))
(command "_.REGION" outline "")
(setq reg (entlast))
(command "_.EXTRUDE" reg "" 35.0)
(setq body (entlast))
(require-one "outer_body")

; Centered 19 mm-high opening, 23 mm deep, leaving a 15 mm rear web.
(command "_.BOX" '(-1.0 0.0 8.0) "_L" 24.0 24.0 19.0)
(setq cut (entlast))
(subtract-cutter body cut "slot_23x24x19")

; Two M4 transverse holes in the arms, axes 30 mm from rear and 27 mm apart.
(command "_.CYLINDER" '(8.0 -1.0 31.0) 2.0 "_A" '(8.0 25.0 31.0))
(setq cut (entlast))
(subtract-cutter body cut "upper_M4")
(command "_.CYLINDER" '(8.0 -1.0 4.0) 2.0 "_A" '(8.0 25.0 4.0))
(setq cut (entlast))
(subtract-cutter body cut "lower_M4")

; M4 transverse hole in rear web, 7.5 mm from the rear edge.
(command "_.CYLINDER" '(30.5 -1.0 17.5) 2.0 "_A" '(30.5 25.0 17.5))
(setq cut (entlast))
(subtract-cutter body cut "rear_web_M4")

; M8 axial through-hole centered on the 24 x 35 rear end.
(command "_.CYLINDER" '(-1.0 12.0 17.5) 4.0 "_A" '(39.0 12.0 17.5))
(setq cut (entlast))
(subtract-cutter body cut "M8_axial")

; Diameter 10 vertical through-hole through both arms.
(command "_.CYLINDER" '(8.0 12.0 -1.0) 5.0 "_A" '(8.0 12.0 36.0))
(setq cut (entlast))
(subtract-cutter body cut "diameter10_vertical")

; Confirm the remaining entity is a native ACIS 3DSOLID.
(setq finalset (ssget "_X" '((0 . "3DSOLID"))))
(if (and finalset (= (sslength finalset) 1))
  (progn
    (setq finalent (ssname finalset 0))
    (princ (strcat "\nFINAL_ENTITY_TYPE=" (cdr (assoc 0 (entget finalent)))))
  )

)

(princ "\nMODEL_COMPLETE")
(princ)

I’m resolving the axial step stack from section C–C before scripting the Boolean construction.

I resolved the section as a 19.90 mm flange with asymmetric axial projections: 9.90 mm on the left and 13.00 mm on the right (32.90 mm from the flange’s left datum to the right end). The internal geometry is a Ø28 through bore with Ø32 bearing seats 10.00 mm deep from both ends and shallow Ø34.40 mouth reliefs; the four flange holes receive Ø9 × 5.50 counterbores from the shown face. (progn
  (setvar "CMDECHO" 0)
  (setvar "DELOBJ" 1)
  (setvar "INSUNITS" 4)
  (command "_.UCS" "_World")
  (defun mkcyl (pt rad ht / e)
    (command "_.CYLINDER" "_non" pt rad ht)
    (setq e (entlast))
    (if (and e (= (cdr (assoc 0 (entget e))) "3DSOLID")) e (progn (princ "\nCYLINDER_FAILED") nil))
  )
  (defun alive (e tag)
    (if (and e (entget e) (= (cdr (assoc 0 (entget e))) "3DSOLID"))
      (princ (strcat "\nCHECK_OK:" tag))
      (princ (strcat "\nCHECK_FAIL:" tag)))
  )
  (setq flange (mkcyl '(0.0 0.0 0.0) 33.0 19.9))
  (setq hubL (mkcyl '(0.0 0.0 -9.9) 21.0 9.9))
  (setq hubR (mkcyl '(0.0 0.0 19.9) 21.0 13.0))
  (alive flange "FLANGE")
  (alive hubL "LEFT_HUB")
  (alive hubR "RIGHT_HUB")
  (command "_.UNION" flange hubL hubR "")
  (setq body (entlast))
  (alive body "UNION_BODY")
  (setq bore (mkcyl '(0.0 0.0 -10.9) 14.0 44.8))
  (command "_.SUBTRACT" body "" bore "")
  (setq body (entlast))
  (alive body "THROUGH_BORE")
  (setq seatL (mkcyl '(0.0 0.0 -9.9) 16.0 10.0))
  (command "_.SUBTRACT" body "" seatL "")
  (setq body (entlast))
  (alive body "LEFT_SEAT")
  (setq seatR (mkcyl '(0.0 0.0 22.9) 16.0 10.0))
  (command "_.SUBTRACT" body "" seatR "")
  (setq body (entlast))
  (alive body "RIGHT_SEAT")
  (setq reliefL (mkcyl '(0.0 0.0 -9.901) 17.2 0.901))
  (command "_.SUBTRACT" body "" reliefL "")
  (setq body (entlast))
  (alive body "LEFT_MOUTH_RELIEF")
  (setq reliefR (mkcyl '(0.0 0.0 31.999) 17.2 0.902))
  (command "_.SUBTRACT" body "" reliefR "")
  (setq body (entlast))
  (alive body "RIGHT_MOUTH_RELIEF")
  (setq ang 0.0)
  (repeat 4
    (setq px (* 26.5 (cos ang)))
    (setq py (* 26.5 (sin ang)))
    (setq bh (mkcyl (list px py -0.1) 2.75 20.1))
    (command "_.SUBTRACT" body "" bh "")
    (setq body (entlast))
    (alive body (strcat "BOLT_THROUGH_" (rtos ang 2 3)))
    (setq cb (mkcyl (list px py -0.001) 4.5 5.501))
    (command "_.SUBTRACT" body "" cb "")
    (setq body (entlast))
    (alive body (strcat "BOLT_COUNTERBORE_" (rtos ang 2 3)))
    (setq ang (+ ang (/ pi 2.0)))
  )
  (setq solids (ssget "_X" '((0 . "3DSOLID"))))
  (if (= (sslength solids) 1)
    (princ "\nFINAL_CHECK_OK:ONE_3DSOLID")
    (princ (strcat "\nFINAL_CHECK_FAIL:SOLID_COUNT=" (itoa (if solids (sslength solids) 0)))))
  (command "_.ZOOM" "_Extents")
  (princ "\nOMNIMECH6_COMPLETE")
  (princ)
)

arguments.lisp:
(progn
  (setvar "CMDECHO" 0)
  (setvar "DELOBJ" 1)
  (command "_.UCS" "_World")
  (defun mkcyl (pt rad ht / e)
    (command "_.CYLINDER" "_non" pt rad ht)
    (setq e (entlast))
    (if (and e (= (cdr (assoc 0 (entget e))) "3DSOLID")) e nil))
  (defun mkcone (pt r1 r2 ht / e)
    (command "_.CONE" "_non" pt r1 "_Top" r2 ht)
    (setq e (entlast))
    (if (and e (= (cdr (assoc 0 (entget e))) "3DSOLID")) e nil))
  (defun alive (e tag)
    (if (and e (entget e) (= (cdr (assoc 0 (entget e))) "3DSOLID"))
      (princ (strcat "\nCHECK_OK:" tag))
      (princ (strcat "\nCHECK_FAIL:" tag))))
  (setq ss (ssget "_X" '((0 . "3DSOLID"))))
  (if (= (sslength ss) 1)
    (setq body (ssname ss 0))
    (progn (princ "\nINPUT_SOLID_COUNT_INVALID") (quit)))
  (alive body "A007_INPUT")
  (setq ang 0.0)
  (repeat 4
    (setq px (* 26.5 (cos ang)))
    (setq py (* 26.5 (sin ang)))
    (setq fillOuter (mkcyl (list px py 10.0) 5.5 5.4))
    (setq fillInner (mkcyl (list px py 9.9) 2.75 5.6))
    (command "_.SUBTRACT" fillOuter "" fillInner "")
    (setq fillRing (entlast))
    (command "_.UNION" body fillRing "")
    (setq body (entlast))
    (alive body "OLD_COUNTERBORE_FILLED")
    (setq leftDeburr (mkcone (list px py 9.999) 3.75 2.75 1.002))
    (command "_.SUBTRACT" body "" leftDeburr "")
    (setq body (entlast))
    (setq newCb (mkcyl (list px py 14.399) 4.5 5.502))
    (command "_.SUBTRACT" body "" newCb "")
    (setq body (entlast))
    (setq newEntry (mkcone (list px py 18.899) 4.5 5.5 1.002))
    (command "_.SUBTRACT" body "" newEntry "")
    (setq body (entlast))
    (alive body (strcat "REVERSED_COUNTERBORE_" (itoa (1+ (fix (/ ang (/ pi 2.0)))))))
    (setq ang (+ ang (/ pi 2.0))))
  (setq finalss (ssget "_X" '((0 . "3DSOLID"))))
  (if (= (sslength finalss) 1)
    (princ "\nFINAL_CHECK_OK:ONE_3DSOLID")
    (princ (strcat "\nFINAL_CHECK_FAIL:SOLID_COUNT=" (itoa (if finalss (sslength finalss) 0)))))
  (command "_.ZOOM" "_Extents")
  (princ "\nA008_COMPLETE")
  (princ)
)
